parsed.template: ${user.name} Active this.handleProfileAction(e.detail.value)} > Edit profile Send message Block user ${user.bio} View profile
assumptions: The "View profile" button is primary, so `variant` is OMITTED — "primary" is not in al-button's variant enum ('secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'bare' | 'danger'); the unset value is the primary state (al-button.doNotFlag: no-variant-attribute-for-primary).
al-avatar renders as a circle by default — no shape/variant attribute is needed for the circular form, per the digest's default-slot description.

The status badge is a textual `<al-badge variant="success">Active</al-badge>` next to the name rather than al-avatar's `hasBadge`/`badgeVariant` dot, because the pattern asks for a labeled "Active" badge. `position` is deliberately unset so the badge flows inline instead of absolutely positioning against the card.

The header cluster uses `<al-layout direction="row" gap="sm" align="center">` rather than a raw `<div>`: al-u-* utilities do not adopt into light-DOM slot content, and arrangement belongs to al-layout. Note a conflict in the docs — cem-digest.json's al-card `header` slot description calls an inline-styled `<div slot="header" style="display:flex;…">` the "sanctioned shape", while AGENTS.md "Header row / atom cluster inside a slot" (rule 2) and CLAUDE.md's "Arrangement belongs to al-layout" both mandate al-layout. I followed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md; the digest line looks stale.

The kebab lives in al-card's `action-right` slot with `position="bottom-right"` so the menu opens downward and inward, per AGENTS.md's anchoring rule. The popover's `trigger` slot auto-wires open/close, so no manual `isActive` binding is used.

`onMenuItemSelect` is bound once on `<al-menu>` (it bubbles + composes from the items) and read via `e.detail.value`; `this.handleProfileAction` is the host component's handler, to be supplied by the consumer.

Menu items rely on their default slot for both visible and accessible name, so `label` is intentionally omitted — setting both `label` and matching slot text would produce a duplicate accessible name.

`<al-icon name="dots-three-vertical">` is the current canonical Phosphor form (the legacy `<al-icon-dots-vertical>` alias is deprecated). The button is icon-only via `hideText` + `label`, with no visible text node in the default slot.

`user.avatarUrl` / `user.name` / `user.bio` are host-component properties; the bio is passed as a text expression into al-text-block rather than wrapped in a `

` to avoid nesting assumptions about the slot.

`<al-theme>` composes on top of the base `dist/css/main.css` bundle, which the app is assumed to load. brand="altitude" and mode="light" are explicit; density/contrast/motion/shape are left unset so they inherit the defaults.
